newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Sisecam group 1996 turnover at 200 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turk Sisecam group 1996 turnover at 200 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's leading glass and glassware producing group Turkiye Sise ve Cam Fabrikalari A.S. increased its turnover to approximately 200 trillion lira in 1996, against 100 trillion lira in 1995, a company official said.

"We exceeded 195 trillion lira by mid-December and year-end reports are progressing and it seems that we have some 200 trillion lira of turnover in 1996," a senior company official who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
The group's 1996 turnover target was 210 trillion lira.
Sisecam group exceeded its 750-million-unit output target in glassware by three percent in 1996 and met the 400,000 tonnes production of flat glass in the same period.

On the other hand, the group realised 90 percent of its 370,000-tonne glass jar and bottle production target and 440,000 tonnes of the 450,000-tonne output target in sodium carbonate and other chemicals in 1996.
The official said they slightly exceeded their $380 million export target for 1996.
"We had $385 million of exports in 1996, unchanged from 1995," he said.
The group also slightly exceeded its $467-million investment programme for 1996 by spending $500 million which almost doubled from the $255 million a year ago.

One of the group's projects is a $22 million co-generation plant to produce electricity and steam power for its needs. The plant with 215 million Kwh electricity and 384,000 tonnes of steam production capacity will be completed in July.
A capacity expansion investment worth $51 million will be completed in two stages, in July 1997 and February 1998, in Soda Sanayii A.S., the group's raw material producing affiliate.
Four of the Sisecam group firms are listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange, alongside Sisecam whose shares ended lower at 14,000 lira on Monday morning, versus Friday's 14,500 close.

Trakya Cam Sanayii A.S., Anadolu Cam Sanayii A.S. and Denizli Cam Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. are glass and glassware units while Tezsan Takim Tezgahlari Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. produces machinery for metal processing.

Trakya Cam which produces flat glass and auto-glass reported 9.86 trillion lira of net sales in the first nine months of 1996, against 5.72 trillion in the same 1995 period. Its shares ended at 6,000 lira on Monday morning, down from Friday's 6,100 close.

Anadolu Cam which manufactures flat glass, bottles and jars reported 2.61 trillion lira of net sales in January-September 1996, up from 1.37 trillion in the same 1995 period. Its shares eased to 2,275 lira on Monday morning from Friday's 2,300 close.

Glassware producer Denizli Cam reported 1.06 trillion lira of net sales in the first nine months of 1996, after 540.7 billion in the same 1995 period. Its shares ended at 8,100 lira on Monday morning, up from 7,700 at Friday's close.

Tezsan Takim's net sales jumped to 841.6 billion lira in January-September 1996, from 209.8 billion lira in the same 1995 period. Its shares finished at 10,250 lira on Monday morning, down from Friday's 10,500 close.
